Initial public release: Batch convert various bank statement Excel files to unified regulatory format.

- Supports .xlsx, .xls (old binary), HTML table .xls, XML spreadsheet .xls, and misnamed .xls files.
- Auto-recognizes formats; users simply provide a folder path with bank statement files.
- Consolidates multiple files into one output Excel with a "汇总" (summary) sheet and individual sheets for each company/source file.
- Standardizes to a 9-column template: 日期 | 收入 | 支出 | 余额 | 摘要 | 对方户名 | 对方银行 | 对方账号 | 备注.
- Skips temporary/summary files and filters out non-data rows.
- Reports on successful and failed conversions, including specific error reasons.
